messages:
Jenna (Sales): LeafBank uploaded a CAIQ + custom security questionnaire. They called out KMS/BYOK and data residency as blockers for the POC. See attachments: <https://files.redwood.com/leafbank/caiq-qa.zip|CAIQ + extras>
Lin (SE): I glanced at it. Two immediate asks from their infra folks: 1) will Dedicated support customer-managed keys during the POC? 2) can we pin the POC to eu-west-1 for data residency?
Jenna (Sales): They want answers before signing the MSA. Also asked for SOC2 report and encryption-at-rest details.
security-queue-bot: New intake created: intake_id=INT-2026-0501, priority=high, submitter=Jenna (Sales)
Marco (Security Eng): Assigned to me. I'll do a CAIQ triage and propose control responses + any gaps. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Quick clarifying q: is the POC targeted at Dedicated (reserved) or Private (VPC)? That changes BYOK options.
Priya (RevOps): Sales says POC should start within 2wks. We need a rough cost estimate if engineering work required.
Lin (SE): Customer prefers Dedicated to move faster, but insists on key ownership long-term. We should validate if Dedicated can host BYOK or if Private is required.
Marco (Security Eng): Short answer: BYOK is supported on Private (customer KMS/HSM). Dedicated currently uses provider-managed keys; enabling BYOK on Dedicated would need an infra change + Ops runbook. I'll capture effort estimate (S/M/L) in the gaps doc.
Jenna (Sales): Include an estimated implementation size so I can quote the POC cost.
Marco (Security Eng): Noted. Two CAIQ areas look incomplete from initial skim:
```
- SC-01: Data flow / where PII is processed/stored
- SC-06: Key lifecycle (rotation, revocation) details
- CM-02: Change control for model updates during POC
```
Lin (SE): I can ask the customer for a sequence diagram and key rotation policy. Template: "Please provide a sequence diagram showing ingress -> storage -> model inference -> any persistent KV cache, and mark where encryption/pseudonymization occurs." Want me to send that?
Jenna (Sales): Yes, send and cc Marco. Emphasize timeline.
security-queue-bot: INT-2026-0501 status -> triage_in_progress (owner=Marco)
Lin (SE): Sent to Alex (infra lead): "Hi Alex — can you share: 1) sequence/network diagram for the POC, 2) key rotation process, 3) desired region(s), 4) any compliance requirements (PCI/SOC2/ISO)."
Jenna (Sales): Alex replied: "We'll upload diagrams + key-policy by tomorrow noon."
Marco (Security Eng): Good. Once we receive docs, I'll map controls and propose either: (A) run POC on Dedicated with provider keys + mitigation controls, or (B) enable BYOK on Dedicated (if low-effort) or move to Private. I'll put recommended contractual wording in the gaps doc regarding key custody.
Priya (RevOps): If we need to fast-track BYOK on Dedicated, I need a price band for: 1) Dedicated w/provider keys, 2) Dedicated + expedited BYOK, 3) Private/VPC with BYOK. Can you include that, Jenna?
Jenna (Sales): Will do. The buyer signaled willingness to pay for expedited infra work; negotiating terms now.
Lin (SE): Customer just uploaded attachments to intake folder: <https://files.redwood.com/leafbank/intake/attachments|attachments> (network-diagram.pdf, key-policy.docx).
security-queue-bot: INT-2026-0501 comment added by Lin (SE)
Marco (Security Eng): Downloading. Plan: review diagrams, confirm whether their key lifecycle matches our BYOK model, and update the intake with a control-gap table. Draft due by 2026-05-02 18:00 UTC.
Priya (RevOps): Please add a short redline clause I can hand to Legal: who controls key rotation, emergency key revocation process, and liability split.
Marco (Security Eng): Will include a suggested clause: "Customer retains key ownership and is responsible for rotation; Provider will not export customer keys and will maintain logs for access attempts." I'll word it conservatively and let Legal refine.
Jenna (Sales): Thanks. I'll flag opportunity as "POC awaiting security triage" and keep sales pipeline updated. :rocket:
Lin (SE): If timeline slips we can run a temporary POC on Dedicated with provider-managed keys + strict access controls and a documented roadmap to BYOK. Usually enough to get initial sign-off.
security-queue-bot: INT-2026-0501 status -> awaiting_customer_artifacts
Jenna (Sales): Alex just confirmed diagrams uploaded. He wrote: "Also note: we need TLS 1.3 and AES-256-GCM details for encryption in transit and at rest."
Marco (Security Eng): Good, we'll attach our crypto spec and SOC2 reference. I'll also annotate any items needing attestation vs those covered by our standard controls.
Priya (RevOps): Once Marco posts the gaps doc, I'll prepare the three price options and open a PO estimate for expedited engineering work if necessary.
Marco (Security Eng): Action items summarized: 1) I will produce CAIQ control mapping + BYOK effort estimate 2) Lin to confirm sequence diagram & key lifecycle with customer 3) Jenna to confirm payer on expedited work and update pipeline 4) Priya to draft price bands once Marco's estimate is in.
Jenna (Sales): Sounds good. I'll update the buyer and loop back. :thumbsup:
